resources.string: Network automation requires single-tunnel userspace mode. Disable kernel mode and multiple simultaneous tunnels first.

Keep the VPN connected and return network handling to Android, with a brief traffic gap.

Automation will stop. The VPN stays connected while fresh protected sockets return network handling to Android. Traffic pauses briefly. If hand-back fails, automation stays off; disconnect and reconnect manually.

Installation returned successfully and the running configuration was observed. This does not prove a working client connection. Create a VPN user to retain a device profile.
The configuration was observed and saved after reconciliation. The earlier installation outcome remains unverified. No installation was retried.
A previous installation requires reconciliation. Do not retry. If no matching configuration can be observed, inspect the server through a trusted administrator.

The private profile will be retained encrypted on this device. This does not import a tunnel. Cancellation cannot undo a remote create already admitted. An uncertain attempt must be checked before another create.
Refresh server status to confirm its WireGuard identity before creating a user. A response without a confirmed identity cannot authorize creation.
Creating the user. The private profile and final server status are not yet confirmed.
Private profile saved encrypted on this device. Final server verification is pending; check this attempt again. QR and export remain unavailable.

The server returned a private profile, but encrypted retention is unconfirmed. Check this attempt again to retry local retention; do not create the user again. Closing Servers or restarting the app can lose the unsaved copy.
Creation outcome is uncertain. Check this attempt again; do not create the user again. Server status alone cannot recover a lost private profile.
A previous create needs reconciliation. Check that attempt before creating another user. A lost private response cannot be rebuilt from server status.

User created and private profile saved encrypted on this device. Server status confirms the peer. VPN traffic is unverified. Open the user to access the profile after authentication and fresh server verification.

This archives the original private peer block on the server before removing access. Any retained private profile on this device is deleted only after peer absence and this operation’s archive are verified. Imported tunnels and exported copies remain. Cancellation cannot undo an admitted remote operation.
Checking the current server, peer identity and revocation history before confirmation.
Archiving and revoking this exact peer. Closing the connection may leave the remote operation running.
Revocation is unverified. Keep the retained private profile and reconcile status before another mutation; a remote operation may still be running.
Server or peer identity changed. Refresh status before reviewing revocation again.
Revocation history cannot be verified. No revocation was admitted. Refresh status after the server history is available.

Revocation returned successfully; peer absence was observed in the server configuration and running interface, and this operation’s private archive was verified on the server. No retained private profile remains for this peer.

The peer is absent from the server configuration and this operation’s private archive was verified on the server. No retained private profile remains for this peer. The interface was stopped; no live revocation was tested.

The requested peer is absent from the server configuration and running interface, and this operation’s private archive was verified on the server. No retained private profile remains for this peer. The earlier command response was not verified.

The requested peer is absent from the server configuration and this operation’s private archive was verified on the server. No retained private profile remains for this peer. The interface was observed stopped; no live revocation was tested.

Revocation failed. The server rejected or rolled back this peer change. Any retained private profile was kept. Refresh status and review a new revocation before trying again.
Revocation history has reached the supported limit. No revocation was admitted. Review server history before trying again.

A new client key is generated and retained encrypted on this device. Address, PSK, other settings and server identity stay unchanged. The old profile is replaced locally only after exact remote verification. Imported tunnels and exported copies keep the old key: replace them explicitly afterward. Cancellation cannot undo an admitted remote operation.

Preparing the encrypted profile and rotating this exact client key. Closing may leave the remote operation running.
Rotation needs reconciliation. Retained private profiles stay protected; reconcile before another mutation. No key is regenerated or resent automatically.

The new client key and preserved settings were verified in the configuration and running interface. The new private profile is retained. Refresh status, then explicitly replace imported tunnels and exported copies; traffic was not tested.

The new client key and preserved settings were verified in the persistent configuration. The interface was stopped. Refresh status, then explicitly replace imported tunnels and exported copies; live use was not tested.

The requested new key and preserved settings were observed in the configuration and running interface. The new private profile is retained; this does not establish the earlier command outcome or traffic. Refresh status and explicitly replace old copies.

The requested new key and preserved settings were observed in persistent configuration; the interface was stopped. The new private profile is retained. Refresh status and explicitly replace old copies; live use was not tested.
